verdicts.reason: A shrinks the MERRY headline to an illegible speck that collides with the Christmas tree, and DISCOUNT becomes the dominant element, which inverts the hierarchy. It also strings every character into one cramped conveyor row on the left, a shrink-and-line-up that loses the original's composition. B keeps MERRY large and legible with DISCOUNT beside it, and characters flank both sides, so it is closer to the original. Its flaws: the heart monster, bell, candy cane and presents are jammed together and overlap just left of MERRY, DISCOUNT is crowded right up against the monsters, and a dead gap sits between the left pair and the centre.
